name: FUN_INTERCO_MASTER_DOCUMENTS
description: This table contains information of master documents for the multitier intercompany flow.

columns.name: MASTER_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the master document

columns.name: MASTER_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number assigned to the master document.

columns.name: PROVIDER_ORG_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the provider organization.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type of master document. All transactions in a master document must have the same transaction type.

columns.name: MANUAL_APPROVAL_FLAG
columns.description: Manual approval indicator for the master document.

columns.name: ALLOW_INVOICING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether invoicing is allowed on master document.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Rate type for conversion from transaction currency.

columns.name: CLEARING_ORG1_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the clearing organization 1.

columns.name: CLEARING_ORG2_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the clearing organization 2.

columns.name: CLEARING_ORG3_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the clearing organization 3.

columns.name: CLEARING_ORG4_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the clearing organization 4.

columns.name: CLEARING_ORG5_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the clearing organization 5.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of intercompany master document.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Transaction currency of the master document.

columns.name: DUE_TO_FROM_CURR_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Basis for currency conversion from transaction currency defined for master document.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of master document.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
